body.x: The Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) is a treaty-based international, inter-governmental organization dedicated to supporting and promoting strong, inclusive and sustainable economic growth in developing countries and emerging economies. To learn more please visit about GGGI web page.

The Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) is an intergovernmental organization supporting its Member and Partner States to achieve environmentally sustainable, socially inclusive and economically resilient growth. In partnership with the Government of Luxembourg, GGGI is preparing the Climate Nexus Finance Facility (CNFF), a five-year global programme (2026–2030) with an estimated budget of EUR 20 million. The Facility aims to strengthen fiscal, financial and public investment frameworks to align financial systems with climate, nature and resilience objectives. Its work includes supporting Ministries of Finance and regulators, National Development Banks, public investment and public–private partnership systems, and the development of bankable climate-resilient and nature-positive investments. The Facility targets mobilization of USD 5 billion toward Climate Nexus objectives, alongside capacity building, investment frameworks, resilient infrastructure projects and climate risk insurance products.

Hiring and appointment to this position are conditional upon signature of the Contribution Agreement between GGGI and the Government of Luxembourg. The anticipated starting date is January 2027, subject to signature and entry into force of the agreement, confirmation of the approved staffing structure and budget, and completion of GGGI recruitment procedures. This Job Description does not constitute an employment commitment.

The Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Associate will support results monitoring, reporting, evidence management and learning for the Climate Nexus Finance Facility (CNFF) and other GGGI Global Sustainable Finance Programs. As part of the Project Support Unit (PSU), the Associate will work closely with the Project Management Unit (PMU), Project Technical Unit (PTU), country teams and GGGI's corporate MEL functions to ensure accurate results tracking, quality reporting and alignment with GGGI's Corporate Results Framework (CRF). The role will also support portfolio-level results consolidation, investment mobilization tracking and knowledge sharing across programs.
Support the implementation of MEL frameworks and reporting processes across CNFF and other Global Sustainable Finance Programs, in alignment with GGGI's Corporate Results Framework.
Maintain reliable results data and supporting evidence to facilitate donor reporting, management decisions and organizational learning.
Support monitoring and verification of program results, including sustainable finance and investment mobilization outcomes.
Coordinate with program managers, technical teams and country teams to collect results information, monitor progress and address reporting gaps.
Liaise with GGGI's corporate MEL and results reporting functions on indicator definitions, methodologies, reporting requirements and validation processes.
Work with Finance, Procurement and other relevant teams to ensure consistency between program results, financial information and donor reporting.
Support coordination with donors and partners on results reporting, evidence requirements and learning activities under management guidance.
Support the development and updating of MEL plans, results frameworks, indicators, baselines, targets and reporting schedules across programs.
Maintain project and portfolio-level monitoring tools, track progress against work plans and results frameworks, and flag delays, risks and data gaps.
Coordinate and consolidate periodic results reporting, including monthly progress updates, donor reports and management reporting.
Review results data for accuracy, completeness and consistency, ensuring adequate supporting evidence and compliance with reporting requirements.
Support tracking and verification of sustainable finance results, including investment mobilization, financial commitments and related outcomes, in coordination with technical teams.
Maintain accurate project and results records in GGGI Online and support corporate results reporting, validation and verification processes.
Consolidate portfolio-level results and prepare summaries, analyses and dashboards to support management decisions and performance reviews.
Maintain organized results documentation and evidence repositories to support donor reporting, audits and evaluations.
Document lessons learned, good practices and stakeholder feedback, and contribute to learning activities and knowledge products.
Bachelor’s degree in international development, economics, public policy, statistics, environmental studies or a related field.
Preferably at least four years of relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation, results management, project reporting or data analysis.
Experience maintaining results frameworks, collecting and checking quantitative and qualitative data, and preparing reports for development programs.
Experience with multi-country or donor-funded programs is desirable; familiarity with climate investment, sustainable finance or investment-results measurement is an advantage.
Proficiency in Excel and data-management tools; experience with dashboards and online project-management systems is desirable.
Fluency in written and spoken English is required; knowledge of French is an asset.
Strong analytical skills and ability to turn technical inputs into clear, evidence-based reporting.
Attention to detail in checking indicator calculations, source documents and consistency of claims.
Ability to coordinate multiple contributors and reporting deadlines and flag issues promptly.
Understanding of results chains, contribution and attribution, data quality and learning methods.
Demonstrates GGGI’s values of Integrity, Excellence and Sustainability and actively supports its mission.
Maintains accountability, confidentiality and transparency and uses public resources responsibly.
Works respectfully and constructively with colleagues and partners across cultures, functions and time zones.
Shares information, supports colleagues and contributes to continuous improvement and organizational learning.

Child protection – GGGI is committed to child protection, irrespective of whether any specific area of work involves direct contact with children. GGGI’s Child Protection Policy is written in accordance with the Convention on the Rights of the Child.
